The deterministic checks confirm these symbols exist in the codebase at the target revision, but the implementing code is not in the provided excerpts.

The proof-of-concept is detailed and demonstrates a plausible state-confusion bug (PUT state persisting into a subsequent POST request when CURLOPT_POST is not explicitly set), which matches the pattern of CVE-2022-32221.

reply: Thank you for the detailed report and proof-of-concept. The issue you describe (POST-after-PUT confusion when CURLOPT_POST is not explicitly set) is plausible and matches the pattern of CVE-2022-32221. However, the source code excerpts provided for triage do not include the option handling implementation (likely in lib/easy.c or lib/setopt.c) where CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, CURLOPT_MIMEPOST, and CURLOPT_COPYPOSTFIELDS are processed. Could you point to the specific file and function where these options are handled, or provide the relevant code sections? This will allow us to verify whether they correctly set data->set.upload = FALSE as CURLOPT_POST does.
